app.name: TikTok
app.description: Users view and explore clips, broadcast in real time, and browse products from merchants. The service delivers a customized viewing stream, simple production utilities, audio and visual enhancements, and numerous preset security settings.

verdict.one_liner: TikTok collects a wide range of personal data including your behavior, location, contacts, and device fingerprint, and shares it with advertisers and business partners for targeted ads.
verdict.summary: TikTok gathers extensive data: account info, content you upload, messages, clipboard, contacts, purchase history, and identity documents. It automatically tracks your usage behavior, inferred interests, gender, age range, device fingerprints (IP, user agent, carrier), location, and analyzes visuals/audio. Cookies and web beacons track browsing. Data comes from social logins, advertisers, and public sources. Shared with business partners, service providers, advertisers, affiliates, researchers, sellers, and authorities. Users can access, delete, update, or rectify data. Retention is broad: kept as long as necessary for the platform, plus legal/safety needs.
verdict.recommendation_reason: TikTok collects extensive personal data and shares it widely with advertisers and partners. While you can delete your account, the app's broad data collection and sharing practices pose significant privacy risks.

red.title: Extensive data collection
red.plain_english: TikTok collects a massive amount of data about you, including your behavior, location, contacts, device details, and even what's in your clipboard.

red.title: Shares data with advertisers
red.plain_english: Your device identifiers and activity data are shared with advertisers and measurement partners to target ads to you.

red.title: Infers sensitive personal traits
red.plain_english: TikTok automatically guesses your interests, gender, and age range by watching what you do in the app.

red.title: Analyzes your video content
red.plain_english: TikTok uses technology to automatically analyze objects and scenery in the videos you upload.

red.title: Broad data retention
red.plain_english: TikTok keeps your data for as long as they think is necessary, including after you delete your account in some cases.

green.title: User data controls available
green.plain_english: You can access, delete, update, or correct your data through TikTok's privacy portal.

green.title: Account deletion possible
green.plain_english: You can delete your entire TikTok account and all associated data.

green.title: Content privacy controls
green.plain_english: You can control who can view your videos and who can send you messages.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: TikTok needs your camera and microphone to record videos, which is the main purpose of the app. It only accesses them when you choose to record.
categories.detail: Camera and microphone are used for video recording, live streaming, and duets. Visual and audio content is analyzed automatically.
categories.policy_excerpt: The platform automatically gathers usage behavior, visual/audio analysis such as objects and scenery.
concerns: Visual and audio content is analyzed automatically

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: TikTok collects your approximate or precise location to show nearby content and ads. This is used for profiling and ad targeting.
categories.detail: Both approximate and precise location are collected.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: TikTok can access your phone contacts to suggest friends. Your contacts are uploaded to TikTok's servers.
categories.detail: Contacts are uploaded to servers for friend suggestions.
concerns: Used for friend suggestions and profiling

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: TikTok needs access to your photos and videos so you can upload content. You choose which files to share.
categories.detail: Storage access is for uploading content.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: TikTok shares your data with advertisers, business partners, service providers, and corporate affiliates to target ads and improve services.
categories.detail: Shared with advertisers, measurement partners, business partners, service providers, affiliates, researchers, sellers, and authorities.
categories.policy_excerpt: Business partners receive profile basics when users sign in via social networks. Service providers include cloud service providers and providers of content moderation services. Advertisers and measurement partners get identifiers and activity data to personalize and measure campaigns.
concerns: May transfer during mergers or sales

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok requires your email, phone number, and can ask for identity documents. This data is linked to your advertising profile.
categories.detail: Account credentials and identity documents collected. Linked to advertising profile.
categories.policy_excerpt: Users directly provide account credentials, uploaded content, messages, clipboard text, purchase details, contacts, and identity documents.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: TikTok constantly tracks what you watch, like, and share to guess your interests, gender, and age. It uses this to show you targeted ads.
categories.detail: Usage behavior, inferred traits, cookies, web beacons track browsing and ad performance.
categories.policy_excerpt: The platform automatically gathers usage behavior, inferred traits like interests, gender and age range. Cookies and web beacons track browsing and ad performance.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: TikTok has been fined for mishandling children's data. The app appeals to young users but has had issues protecting their privacy.
categories.detail: TikTok has faced regulatory action for children's data protection failures.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: TikTok logs your IP address and internet activity. It uses this to figure out where you are and what you like.
categories.detail: IP address, user agent, mobile carrier logged. Used for location inference and profiling.
categories.policy_excerpt: device fingerprints including IP address, user agent, mobile carrier

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: TikTok builds a detailed fingerprint of your device including your IP address, carrier, and unique identifiers to track you across sessions.
categories.detail: Device fingerprints including IP, user agent, mobile carrier collected continuously.
categories.policy_excerpt: device fingerprints including IP address, user agent, mobile carrier

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok does not collect health or biometric data like heart rate or fingerprints.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection mentioned.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: TikTok collects purchase details when you buy things in the app. It does not store your full credit card number.
categories.detail: Purchase details collected. Payment processing likely handled by third parties.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can ask TikTok to delete your data, but they keep some of it for legal and safety reasons even after you delete your account.
categories.detail: Users can access, delete, update, rectify data. But retention is broad: kept as long as necessary for platform, legal, safety, and business interests.
categories.policy_excerpt: Users can request to access, delete, update, or rectify your data through TikTok's privacy portal. Information is kept as long as necessary to provide the Platform, plus periods needed for legal compliance, safety, and legitimate business interests.
concerns: Some data kept after account deletion

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The policy does not clearly say how TikTok will tell you if the privacy rules change.
categories.detail: No specific information about policy change notification found in the provided text.
